patch_description: The current score is near zero because the initial layout contains many collinear points on the base edge (four points at y=0), so the starting min-area is exactly 0 and the annealer starts from a fully degenerate configuration where the "smallest triangle" is not unique — the random walk wastes most of its 6000 iterations escaping a flat landscape. A better strategy from Heilbronn optimization practice: (1) start from several non-degenerate, quasi-uniform structured layouts (triangular lattice perturbations) via deterministic multi-start; (2) make moves targeted — perturb one of the vertices of the currently-smallest triangle, which is far more effective than uniform random point selection at breaking collinearity bottlenecks; (3) use a proper geometric cooling schedule with a larger initial step size. All remains deterministic (fixed seeds per restart).
